benefit_text: The scheme pays Rs. 6000 per annum per family. The money is paid in three equal installments of Rs 2000 each. Each installment comes every four months.
who_can_apply: Landholding farmer families can apply. The family must have cultivable land in its name.
documents: The papers needed are Aadhaar Card and landholding papers. A savings bank account is also needed.
how_to_apply: The application is done via CSCs. The VLE fills the farmer registration details. Farmers carry Aadhaar Card and landholding papers and savings bank account.
